_comment: Human-reviewed license exceptions for --license-curations. See cli/parsers/sbom.py's LicenseCuration/load_license_curations() for the schema and cli/main.py's --license-curations help text for what this can and can't override -- it rescues a component with zero license metadata from Syft into a resolved, audited state, but can never launder a component whose asserted license itself classifies as forbidden under DEFAULT_LICENSE_POLICY. Keyed by PURL, name-only (no @version) so an entry survives a routine dependency version bump without going stale.
